name: historytracers
description: History Tracers is a free, open-source educational project that teaches mathematics, science, history, literature and genealogy through culture, games and primary sources. Content is available in English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: open_history_tracers_page
tools.description: Open a History Tracers page by page name and optional content UUID.

page.description: Page name, for example class_content, physics, chemistry, atlas, history, literature, families or math_games.

arg.description: Optional content UUID or page argument, used with class_content and tree pages.
